description: Rotate one of your tokens: mint a new secret with the same name, scopes / permissions, repository and expiry, returned ONCE as `token`. `grace_seconds` (default 0, max 604800 = 7 days) keeps the old secret working that long; 0 kills it now. Rotating again ends an earlier grace period. `expected_rotation_count` (from gluecron_get_token's rotationCount) makes it compare-and-swap; two concurrent rotations never both win. `type` is pat (personal access token, glc_), repo (repository token, gcft_) or deploy (deploy token, gcdt_). PATs need 'admin' scope; repository and deploy tokens need 'repo'. Audit-logged.

expected_rotation_count.description: Optional compare-and-swap guard: the rotationCount you last saw.

grace_seconds.description: Seconds the old secret keeps working (0 to 604800). Default 0.

type.description: Token type: pat (personal access token, glc_), repo (repository token, gcft_) or deploy (deploy token, gcdt_)

name: gluecron_rotate_token
